class.name: LuaRuntime
class.brief_description: Embedded Lua 5.4 runtime with restricted engine bindings.
class.description: Each instance owns a separate Lua state, supports syntax checking and protected execution, and exposes a small Nexo API. Bind a Node with set_target_node before using node or scene operations.

method.name: check_syntax
method.description: Compile source without executing it. Returns ok, error, line, and kind fields.

method.name: check_file
method.description: Read and compile a Lua file without executing it.

method.name: execute_string
method.description: Execute source with a protected call. Runtime errors are returned and sent to engine error output.

method.name: execute_file
method.description: Read and execute a Lua file with a protected call.

method.name: call_function
method.description: Call a named global Lua function with an optional delta argument. Missing callbacks are treated as no-ops.

method.name: set_target_node
method.description: Set the current Node context used by Nexo.node and Nexo.scene APIs.

method.name: get_target_node
method.description: Return the current target node, or null if it was freed.

method.name: select_node
method.description: Select a child node relative to the current target for subsequent Lua engine calls.

method.name: reset
method.description: Recreate the Lua state and clear script globals.

method.name: set_instruction_budget
method.description: Set the Lua VM instruction budget for each execution.

method.name: get_instruction_budget
method.description: Return the configured VM instruction budget.
